facts.claim: Edinburgh’s Christmas runs 14 November 2026–3 January 2027; main sites include East Princes Street Gardens, West Princes Street Gardens and George Street.
facts.sourceLocation: Edinburgh’s Christmas runs from 14 November 2026 to 03 January 2027; There are three main sites to explore.
